peerMapping.justification: The construction uses DRAM as the single primary hedge because the displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 9.122 USD millions and the theme tracks memory more closely than SP500 at 30.814 USD millions or XYZ100 at 21.944 USD millions, while EWY at 3.37 USD millions adds South Korea index mix and SOXL at 0.408 USD millions is leveraged. Peer weights are positive, sum to 1, and put direct memory economics first: MU and SNDK dominate, SMSN and CXMT remain direct but liquidity-capped, and INTC plus NVDA are smaller semiconductor-cycle diversifiers. All liquidity figures are preserved as USD millions.

peers.name: Micron Technology
peers.reason: Micron is the closest listed DRAM and NAND comparator, with product mix and memory cycle sensitivity most like SK hynix; its displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 11.877 USD millions.

peers.name: Sandisk
peers.reason: SNDK is the closest independent storage-memory comparator, with NAND exposure and the strongest peer liquidity at 31.164 USD millions, even above SKHX at 18.246 USD millions, so it carries the largest peer weight.

peers.name: Samsung Electronics common
peers.reason: Samsung Electronics common has large DRAM and NAND exposure, but the weight is diluted by foundry, phones, and consumer electronics; its displayed 24-hour perp liquidity is 2.55 USD millions.

peers.name: CXMT Corp. Class A
peers.reason: CXMT Corp. Class A is a focused DRAM manufacturer, giving strong economic comparability, but its thinner displayed 24-hour perp liquidity of 2.38 USD millions and Class A market access argue for a capped weight.

peers.name: Intel
peers.reason: Intel is a large semiconductor comparable with manufacturing and AI compute exposure, but it is less memory-pure, so displayed 24-hour perp liquidity of 6.434 USD millions supports only a mid-sized weight.

peers.name: NVIDIA
peers.reason: NVDA is not a memory maker, but it is the key AI-accelerator demand driver for high-bandwidth memory; its 24-hour perp liquidity of 3.384 USD millions supports a moderate weight tied to demand rather than supply overlap.

primary_index_hedge.name: Roundhill Memory ETF
primary_index_hedge.reason: DRAM is the closest listed hedge to SK hynix common because it is memory-focused rather than broad market, is classified as equity_etf, and has displayed 24-hour perp liquidity of 9.122 USD millions; it avoids the leverage of SOXL and the broader South Korea or mega-cap index mix in EWY, SP500, and XYZ100.

peerMapping.historyMethod: daily-rebalanced peer spot total returns using the fixed Kimi weights; unavailable pre-listing peers are omitted and remaining weights renormalized once at least three peers exist; the browser rebases the basket to the target spot level at the first shared date of each selected chart range

liveSplice.method: current TradeXYZ perp mid divided by that peer's TradeXYZ close on its latest spot date; available Kimi weights renormalized and applied as a one-period return from the published peer spot endpoint; USD cash close is retained for disclosure but never mixed with a differently scaled perp contract

underlierSelection.method: highest summed live contract volume; open interest and contract count break ties

model.name: ATM-straddle-implied lognormal distribution
model.description: Each target uses the nearest paired liquid ATM call and put. Their combined ask implies the expiration distribution shown on the chart.
model.measure: option-implied, not a historical or physical forecast
